sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

rules.name: Spirit Vessel
rules.basis: Valve /datafeed/itemdata Spirit Vessel (fetched 2026-11-07): Soul Release on an enemy cuts its health restoration by 70% and drains 4% of its current health per second for 8 s (10 s cooldown, 750 cast range, charges from hero deaths within 1500). High-rank Bounty Hunters against Huskar, Lifestealer, Oracle, Necrophos or Alchemist: Spirit Vessel in 29% of 58 games (18% otherwise), won 59% against 54%; STRATZ pos4 has it at ~17 min in 27% of games. Track (Valve: +8/12/16% damage taken for 25 s) marks the kill the Vessel keeps from healing back.

reason.en: {enemy} heals a lot: your {item} cuts their health restoration by 70% for 8 s, so the hero you Track cannot heal out of the kill
reason.uk: {enemy} багато лікується: ваш {item} на 8 с знижує їхнє відновлення здоров'я на 70%, тож герой із вашим Track не вилікується з-під добивання

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 98% (-2), tranquil_boots 83% (7), magic_wand 71% (10), urn_of_shadows 43% (12), ring_of_basilius 23% (12), headdress 40% (15), diadem 24% (16), ancient_janggo 43% (16), staff_of_wizardry 64% (22), cyclone 38% (24), ring_of_tarrasque 36% (24), boots_of_bearing 27% (24), great_famango 22% (24), force_staff 35% (25), pers 30% (28), platemail 22% (28), aghanims_shard 26% (31). Reviewed: Drum of Endurance is skipped once Boots of Bearing is owned (its part, bought ~8 min earlier); Tranquil Boots, Urn of Shadows and parts are not listed (under 1000 gold or parts). STRATZ pos4 (8044 games): Drum 14 min 41%, Spirit Vessel 17 min 27%, Eul's 21 min 54% (won 61%) - the Vessel step is left to the healing rule.

skills.basis: 238 games since 7.41: maxed bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss > bounty_hunter_wind_walk > bounty_hunter_jinada 86 (win 65.1%), bounty_hunter_wind_walk > bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss > bounty_hunter_jinada 74 (win 64.9%), bounty_hunter_wind_walk > bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss 22 (win 63.6%); talents 10: Shuriken Toss Slow 203/234 (61.6%), +30 Damage 31/234 (71.0%); 15: Damage Taken in Shadow Walk 152/168 (70.4%), Track Gold 16/168 (75.0%); 20: Track Grants Shared Vision 52/58 (73.1%), Jinada Gold Steal 6/58 (100.0%); 25: Shuriken Toss Damage 20/22 (75.0%), No Cooldown on Jinada 2/22 (100.0%).

notes.basis: Valve Track (fetched 2026-11-07): grants True Sight of the target for 25 s, +8/12/16% damage taken, 1000 cast range, 6/5/4 s cooldown, and casting it does not take you out of Shadow Walk.
